items.passage: Transcript: Hi everyone, this is Imogen Valdez at the library's research help desk. Our citation workshop usually meets on Wednesdays at 11 a.m. in Room 214. This week, though, Room 214 is booked for make-up exams, so the workshop has to move. We first thought we'd simply shift it to Wednesday at 9, but the only free room is Room 318, up on the third floor, and it isn't available on Wednesday at all. It's open on Tuesday, but at 11 there's a faculty meeting in there, so the session will be Tuesday at 9 a.m. Room 318 doesn't have any computers. Normally the second half of the workshop is hands-on database practice, so this week we'll do just the talk, and the practice part will be added on to next week's session. There's no need to bring a laptop. If you can't make the new time, call extension 4417 and we'll put you down for next week.
items.prompt: [Announcement — University library] When will this week's citation workshop take place?
items.explanation: The speaker concludes, "so the session will be Tuesday at 9 a.m." "Wednesday at 11 a.m." is the usual time ("usually meets on Wednesdays at 11 a.m."), which changes this week. "Wednesday at 9 a.m." was only the first idea, rejected because Room 318 "isn't available on Wednesday at all." "Tuesday at 11 a.m." is ruled out because "at 11 there's a faculty meeting in there."
